questions.question: In the context of Stereoisomerism, what is the major organic product when (±)-Mandelic acid reacts under the following conditions: (R)-(+)-1-Phenylethylamine in EtOH?

options.label: C
options.text: Diastereomeric salt mixture separable by crystallization

questions.correct_answer: Diastereomeric salt mixture separable by crystallization
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Chiral amine resolves racemic carboxylic acid by forming pairs of diastereomeric salts with different solubilities. The correct major product is 'Diastereomeric salt mixture separable by crystallization'.

questions.question: In the context of Stereoisomerism, what is the major organic product when cis-2-Butene reacts under the following conditions: H₂ / Pt catalyst?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Syn addition of two hydrogens across the planar cis-alkene face generates an achiral alkane. The correct major product is 'meso-Butane (Achiral butane)'.

questions.question: In the context of Stereoisomerism, what is the major organic product when trans-2-Butene reacts under the following conditions: Br₂ / CCl₄, 0°C?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Anti-stereospecific addition through a bridged cyclic bromonium ion on trans-2-butene yields the meso diastereomer. The correct major product is 'meso-2,3-Dibromobutane'.

questions.question: In the context of Stereoisomerism, what is the major organic product when cis-2-Butene reacts under the following conditions: Br₂ in CCl₄, 0°C?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Anti-addition of bromine across cis-2-butene yields an equimolar racemic pair of enantiomers. The correct major product is '(±)-(2R,3R)/(2S,3S)-2,3-Dibromobutane (Racemic)'.

questions.question: In the context of Stereoisomerism, what is the major organic product when (R)-2-Bromobutane reacts under the following conditions: NaI in dry Acetone?
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Concerted backside nucleophilic attack inverts the chiral configuration from (R) to (S). The correct major product is '(S)-2-Iodobutane + NaBr(s)'.

questions.question: Which reaction conditions / reagents are required to convert cis-2-Butene into meso-Butane-2,3-diol in Stereoisomerism?
questions.explanation: Reagent selection rationale: The transformation 'cis-2-Butene' → 'meso-Butane-2,3-diol' specifically requires 'OsO₄ / NMO aqueous acetone'. Mechanistic basis: Concerted syn-addition of two hydroxyl groups across cis-2-butene yields the meso-diol.

questions.question: Which reaction conditions / reagents are required to convert trans-2-Butene into (±)-(2R,3R)/(2S,3S)-Butane-2,3-diol (Racemic) in Stereoisomerism?
questions.explanation: Reagent selection rationale: The transformation 'trans-2-Butene' → '(±)-(2R,3R)/(2S,3S)-Butane-2,3-diol (Racemic)' specifically requires 'OsO₄ / NMO in acetone'. Mechanistic basis: Concerted syn-dihydroxylation across trans-2-butene creates a racemic mixture of chiral diols.

questions.question: Which reaction conditions / reagents are required to convert cis-2-Butene into (±)-(2R,3R)/(2S,3S)-Butane-2,3-diol in Stereoisomerism?
questions.explanation: Reagent selection rationale: The transformation 'cis-2-Butene' → '(±)-(2R,3R)/(2S,3S)-Butane-2,3-diol' specifically requires '1. mCPBA  2. Aqueous H₃O⁺'. Mechanistic basis: Anti-dihydroxylation via epoxide ring opening inverts one stereocenter, converting cis-alkene to racemic diol.

questions.question: Which starting material yields '(R)-1-Phenylethan-1-ol (>95% ee)' when treated with '(R)-CBS Catalyst / BH₃·THF' according to the principles of Stereoisomerism?

questions.question: Which starting material yields '2-Menthene (Non-Zaitsev product exclusively)' when treated with 'NaOEt / EtOH, 80°C' according to the principles of Stereoisomerism?
